item.title: CVE-2026-121808 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification) vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_core and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via a compressed Erlang external term in a gRPC message body.
GRPC.Codec.Erlpack.decode/2 (grpc_core/lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex, and lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex before the package split) passes the message body to :erlang.binary_to_term/2. That function inflates a compressed term in full before it returns. The codec sets no limit on the decoded size, and its type checks run only on the decoded term. The server's max_body_size limit counts the compressed bytes of the request. A request with Content-Type: application/grpc+erlpack can therefore make the server allocate a term much larger than the request body.
This issue affects grpc: from 0.4.0 before 1.0.0; grpc_core: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-123635 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows a client to stall all later calls on a shared HTTP/2 connection via calls that the server refuses while their DATA frames are in flight.
The stream handler grpc_stream_h (grpc_server/src/grpc_stream_h.erl) requests flow from Cowboy only for request data that has arrived. When the server refuses a call early, for example because the body exceeds max_body_size or the method is not implemented, Cowboy drops the DATA frames still in flight for that stream. Their bytes are not returned to the connection flow-control window. After enough refused calls the window is empty. No call on that connection can then send a request body, and each call waits until its deadline. Other connections are not affected.
This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-124278 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server and grpc allows an attacker to make a handler act on a resource other than the one named in the URL of an HTTP-transcoded route, via a request with a gRPC Content-Type.
Only the transcoding clause of GRPC.Server.do_handle_request/4 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server.ex, and lib/grpc/server.ex before the package split) applies the route's path bindings to the request message. The Cowboy handler picks that clause from the request Content-Type, not from the route. A request to a transcoded URL with application/grpc or application/grpc-web is decoded from the body alone, so every path-bound field takes its value from the body. A gateway, proxy rule or WAF that authorizes on the URL path sees one resource while the handler receives another.
This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0; grpc: from 0.8.0 before 1.0.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-126817 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0

item.title: CVE-2026-128034 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5 | In gittuf before 0.18.0, verification of file protection rules uses the quoted, escaped pathnames that Git prints by default for files with special characters (for example non-ASCII characters) instead of the raw paths. Such paths do not match patterns like file:internal/*, so the files are treated as unprotected, and a user who is not authorized by a file protection rule can change a protected file whose name contains special characters and still pass verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-128035 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5 | In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.17.0, the verification workflow does not load policy updates that are propagated from an upstream (controller) repository and recorded in the reference state log after the first entry being verified. Only the propagated policy in effect at the start of verification is applied, so later controller changes to global rules, such as threshold requirements and force-push blocks, are ignored and changes that these rules should block pass verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-128036 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 2.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 2.3 | In gittuf 0.4.0 through 0.16.0, when a policy update appears within the range of reference state log entries being verified, verification checks only the root of trust signatures of the new policy and not the signatures of its other metadata (rule files). A user trusted to push to the repository who bypasses gittuf policy apply and writes the policy reference and reference state log directly can make an invalid policy apply during verification, weakening or strengthening the rules for later changes. The update is still recorded in the reference state log.

item.title: CVE-2026-128037 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.15.0, when a minimum threshold global rule and a policy rule protect the same namespace, verification gives the global rule's check over all trusted users in the policy precedence over the policy rule's own authorized users. A user listed in the policy file but not authorized by the policy rule, or fewer users than the rule's threshold, can make changes to the protected namespace that pass verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-62972 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, lighting_command_decode in src/bacnet/lighting.c decodes its first field with the bounded apdu_size - apdu_len, but every nested decode in the operation switch is called with the original full apdu_size while the read pointer has been advanced to &apdu[apdu_len]. The leaf decoders bound their reads against the size they are told, so they read up to apdu_len bytes past the end of the caller's buffer, resulting in an out-of-bounds read. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-62973 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-95377 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4 | OS command injection in the TFTP provisioning module of Zenitel EdgeAudioClient before 9.6.3.0, and 10.x before 10.1.3.0, on VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted DHCP option 66 (TFTP Server Name) value supplied by a rogue DHCP server on the same network segment. The DHCP-supplied value is passed to a shell without sanitization. Devices using DHCP, the default configuration, are affected on every boot and lease renewal.
The same injection is also reachable via the config_update_tftp_server and sw_update_tftp_server configuration fields by an attacker able to modify the device configuration.

item.title: CVE-2026-95378 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Path traversal in the certificate upload endpoint (/api/certificate/upload) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files as root via a crafted filename parameter in a multipart upload request when the type field is set to any value other than https_certificate. In that case, both path validation and certificate content validation are skipped.
This can be escalated to arbitrary code execution as root, for example by overwriting startup scripts or planting SSH keys.

item.title: CVE-2026-95379 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0
item.description:
Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0 | Path traversal in the certificate.deleteCertificate JSON-RPC method (POST /api/rpc) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to delete arbitrary files as root via a relative path (../) in the file_name parameter.
This can be used to cause denial of service or render the device inoperable by removing critical system files, and to weaken device security by removing files such as firewall rules or certificate trust stores.
